question: 19. If something new happens, does ____________ look at your face to see how you feel about it?

ask_strange_noise.text: If your child hears a strange or scary noise, will he/she look at you **before** responding?

ask_someone_new.text: Does your child **look at you** when someone new approaches?

ask_unfamiliar_scary.text: Does your child **look at you** when he/she is faced with something unfamiliar or a little scary?
